title: Bevel hero
description: A soft app-launch hero: a frame inset 8px from the window with 24px corners, washed from pale sky blue to white with a faint tinted light band, a big centered semibold title, a grey lead, a dark pill button and a star rating, then a tall device shot rising out of the bottom edge into white. On desktop small frosted metric chips take turns floating in and out around the device.
notes: leaves ~90px at the top for the fixed bevel header
media (device), backdrop (sky) and streak (light video) are slots; empty they are token placeholders
the chip loop is CSS only and stops under reduced motion
name: bevel-hero

props.name: title
props.description: the page title (two lines at desktop, three on phones)

props.name: cta
props.type: { label: ReactNode; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }

props.name: rating
props.description: star rating out of five (halves allowed)

props.name: ratingLabel
props.description: the small text after the stars

props.name: media
props.description: the device shot (phone + watch); a phone-shaped placeholder when empty

props.name: backdrop
props.description: the sky behind the top of the frame; a soft accent wash when empty

props.name: streak
props.description: the light-streak video behind the device; a soft tinted band when empty

props.name: chips
props.description: up to four metric chips that take turns floating in around the device (desktop)
